title: Holloman footage debunked as an F-4
place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: But there's also a little bit of footage and that footage has now been debunked as an F4.
This DVD, however, was a gamecher. I quickly fast forwarded to the landing footage and was momentarily stunned by what that extra detail revealed.
tellings.difference: Credits the debunk to the HD DVD release (c. 2024-2025) and calls the object only a plane, not an F-4.
tellings.link_reason: The Holloman landing footage is shown to be an ordinary aircraft. That is the same debunk the story describes.

as_told.title: HD release shows the Holloman 'landing' footage is a plane
as_told.place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

plain: Film said to show a UFO landing at Holloman Air Force Base in New Mexico in the 1970s has, according to later accounts, turned out to show an ordinary military plane. The footage appears in a documentary called UFOs: Past, Present and Future. Michels says so in a 2025 episode with the writer Greg Bishop: there is "a little bit of footage", and it "has now been debunked as an F4", meaning an F-4, a US military fighter jet. An unnamed documentary narrator, played in a 2026 episode with the researcher Grant Cameron, tells how this came to light. The narrator says a newer high-definition DVD release of the film, from around 2024 or 2025, was "a gamechanger". Skipping ahead to the landing footage, the narrator was "momentarily stunned by what that extra detail revealed." In that telling the object is simply a plane, not an F-4 by name. Either way, the claim matters because the landing film had long been offered as evidence of a meeting at a US base.
